Name: No Stump Winter Trees
Author: jenf1
Description:
Tired of Mushroom and Fern Trees becoming stumps in the winter? This mod fixes that!

[b]This mod will only work with SDV 1.6![/b]

Known Issue: If you're currently in the middle of winter and this mod is installed, any existing Mushroom and Fern Tree stumps will remain stumps. The following winter they should no longer become stumps.

Fern Tree stumps have snow on them during the winter. The bottom part of the tree will still appear to be snow-covered. A fix for this will be implemented later.

Install:

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
- Copy [CP] No Stump Winter Trees into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

Downloads.Description:
Requires SDV 1.6!

Please delete the old [CP] Winter Mushroom Trees ENTIRELY from your mods folder!
